name: search_symbols
description: Search symbols across configured providers.

query.description: Ticker or company-name search text; use returned ticker symbols in subsequent tools.

name: get_quotes
description: Batch quotes with source, market time, download time and declared delay. Missing symbols are reported.

name: get_bars
description: Historical OHLCV with provenance, adjustment and offline-cache status. Missing OHLC is null, never fabricated.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_expirations
description: List option expiration dates.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_option_chain
description: Paginated option contracts with source metadata and non-executable midpoint/last entry references (missing quotes stay null). Request expiry YYYY-MM-DD and optional right/strike filters.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

expiry.description: Listed option expiration YYYY-MM-DD; discover actual dates with get_expirations.

right.description: Option right; use the exact call/put enum spelling in this schema.

minStrike.description: Inclusive strike filter in underlying quote currency; not an option premium.

maxStrike.description: Inclusive strike filter in underlying quote currency; not an option premium.

name: get_fundamentals
description: Company fundamentals with source and freshness metadata.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_financials
description: Financial statements with source and freshness metadata.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_news
description: Recent provider news, retaining publisher, URL and publication time.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_market_events
description: Recent news and current earnings/ex-dividend calendar snapshot, with source, exact/date-only timing and estimate/confirmation metadata. Not a historical corporate-action archive.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_source_health
description: Source health observed in THIS process only; unknown is not a successful connectivity check.

name: calculate_option
description: European Black-Scholes price/Greeks and optional solved IV; decimal units (0.25=25%). No network.

right.description: Option right; use the exact call/put enum spelling in this schema.

spot.description: Underlying price per share. Use an observed quote or explicitly label a hypothetical scenario.

strike.description: Option strike per share in the underlying quote currency.

years.description: years argument for calculate_option; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

volatility.description: Annualized IV as a decimal fraction, e.g. 0.25 = 25%; state observed versus assumed/model-derived origin.

price.description: Optional observed per-share price for IV solving

name: calculate_indicators
description: SMA, EMA and RSI on supplied close prices. Warm-up values are null. No network.

closes.description: closes argument for calculate_indicators; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

name: analyze_strategy
description: Position expiry P/L, boundedness, breakevens, optional pre-expiry Greeks and Reg-T estimate. Mixed expiries require valuationTime and IV. No network.

legs.description: Explicit position legs. Preserve entry premiums, side, expiry, quantity and multiplier; never fabricate quotes.

spot.description: Underlying price per share. Use an observed quote or explicitly label a hypothetical scenario.

rate.description: Annual continuously compounded rate as a decimal fraction, e.g. 0.04 = 4%; obtain pricing assumptions before valuation.

dividendYield.description: Annual dividend yield as a decimal fraction, e.g. 0.02 = 2%; preserve provenance and unavailable-yield fallback.

low.description: Underlying-price bound for the payoff/scenario plot, not an option premium.

high.description: Underlying-price bound for the payoff/scenario plot, not an option premium.

name: get_watchlists
description: Read grouped watchlists from the local desktop data directory.

name: create_watchlist_group
description: Create a local watchlist group.

name: rename_watchlist_group
description: Rename a local watchlist group.

groupId.description: Existing local watchlist group id returned by get_watchlists; never substitute its display name.

name: delete_watchlist_group
description: Remove a group; its symbols move to the first remaining group. The last group cannot be deleted.

groupId.description: Existing local watchlist group id returned by get_watchlists; never substitute its display name.

description: Add a ticker to a group.

groupId.description: Existing local watchlist group id returned by get_watchlists; never substitute its display name.

name: remove_watchlist_symbol
description: Remove a ticker from a group.

groupId.description: Existing local watchlist group id returned by get_watchlists; never substitute its display name.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_saved_strategies
description: Read saved local strategies.

name: save_strategy
description: Save/replace a local strategy by name, using desktop-compatible JSON.

name.description: Local strategy name; saving an existing name replaces it. Read saved strategies first.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

legs.description: Explicit position legs. Preserve entry premiums, side, expiry, quantity and multiplier; never fabricate quotes.

name.description: Local strategy name; saving an existing name replaces it. Read saved strategies first.

name: get_alerts
description: Read local alert rules. Desktop remains responsible for continuous monitoring.

name: get_alert_history
description: Read paginated local alert history.

name: save_alert
description: Create a rule, or update an existing id while retaining monitor bookkeeping. Does not start monitoring.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

kind.description: Alert trigger category; select the exact enum value in the schema.

threshold.description: Alert trigger threshold in the selected kind's units; inspect the kind and existing rule before updating.

id.description: Existing alert rule id from get_alerts; omit only when save_alert creates a new rule.

enabled.description: Whether this local alert rule is enabled. Desktop owns continuous monitoring.

repeat.description: repeat argument for save_alert; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

includeExtendedHours.description: Whether the desktop rule may evaluate valid pre/after-market quotes.

note.description: Optional user note for this alert; treated as literal text.

name: delete_alert
description: Delete an alert rule; history is retained.

id.description: Existing alert rule id from get_alerts; omit only when save_alert creates a new rule.

name: set_alert_enabled
description: Enable/disable and re-arm a local alert rule.

id.description: Existing alert rule id from get_alerts; omit only when save_alert creates a new rule.

enabled.description: Whether this local alert rule is enabled. Desktop owns continuous monitoring.

name: probe_data_sources
description: Actively probe configured provider identities using the desktop router. Results apply to this process and the probed endpoint only; not a test of every capability. No arbitrary URLs.

sourceId.description: Optional registered provider id; omitted probes all

name: clear_alert_history
description: Clear local alert history, retaining alert rules and monitor state. Explicit write.

name: move_watchlist_symbol
description: Reorder one symbol within a watchlist group; target index is zero-based. Conflict-safe local write.

groupId.description: Existing local watchlist group id returned by get_watchlists; never substitute its display name.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

toIndex.description: toIndex argument for move_watchlist_symbol; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

name: get_chart_analysis
description: All desktop K-line indicators (MA/EMA/BOLL/MACD/RSI/KDJ) and real volume on provider bars, computed before pagination; incomplete OHLC remains null. Optional comparison is rebased only on common timestamps.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

indicators.description: Optional shared indicator parameter overrides; observe nested bounds and null warm-up values.

compareSymbol.description: Optional comparison ticker. Rebase only on shared timestamps and retain missing-basis uncertainty.

name: analyze_option_chain
description: Desktop option enrichment, IV smile, Greeks, spread/distance and previous local OI. Missing spot/quotes stay missing. Uses configured pricing assumptions; optional valuationTime makes time deterministic.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

valuationTime.description: ISO-8601 instant; default chain snapshot time

name: get_pricing_assumptions
description: Configured/fetched risk-free rate with origin and symbol dividend yield. Unavailable yield falls back to zero explicitly.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_volatility_insights
description: Current IV, IV rank/percentile from existing local history, and up to eight ATM term expirations. Does not record new history; insufficient history is explicit.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: record_option_snapshot
description: Record current IV and OI into the shared local SQLite history. Explicit write; no background monitoring. Does not invent past observations.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

expiry.description: Optional OI expiration YYYY-MM-DD; IV remains IV30/ATM nearest 30 days

name: list_strategy_presets
description: Discover every supported strategy preset and its near/far expiry requirements. Custom legs use analyze_strategy/save_strategy.

name: build_strategy
description: Build any desktop preset from caller-supplied listed reference quotes using the shared Analytics strike selection. No network/save; reference premiums are not executable quotes.

kind.description: Strategy/drawing category; select the exact schema enum and required matching fields.

spot.description: Underlying price per share. Use an observed quote or explicitly label a hypothetical scenario.

quotes.description: quotes argument for build_strategy; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

farQuotes.description: farQuotes argument for build_strategy; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

quantity.description: Number of option contracts for a preset. Explicit stock legs use shares and multiplier 1.

wingSteps.description: Preset wing width in listed strike steps, not a raw dollar distance.

name: strategy_what_if
description: Position and per-leg values/P&L/facts at an assumed price, with optional future horizon and IV shift. No GUI state/save. Mixed expiry requires valuationTime.

legs.description: Explicit position legs. Preserve entry premiums, side, expiry, quantity and multiplier; never fabricate quotes.

spot.description: Underlying price per share. Use an observed quote or explicitly label a hypothetical scenario.

valuationTime.description: ISO-8601 instant; omitted means intrinsic settlement for same-expiry legs

horizonDays.description: Calendar days forward from the explicit valuation time; see schema bounds.

rate.description: Annual continuously compounded rate as a decimal fraction, e.g. 0.04 = 4%; obtain pricing assumptions before valuation.

dividendYield.description: Annual dividend yield as a decimal fraction, e.g. 0.02 = 2%; preserve provenance and unavailable-yield fallback.

volatility.description: Annualized IV as a decimal fraction, e.g. 0.25 = 25%; state observed versus assumed/model-derived origin.

volatilityShift.description: Additive decimal IV shift: 0.05 means five volatility points, not 5 percent relative change.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

kind.description: Strategy/drawing category; select the exact schema enum and required matching fields.

price1.description: Drawing anchor price in the underlying quote currency; not a screen coordinate.

price2.description: Drawing anchor price in the underlying quote currency; not a screen coordinate.

index.description: index argument for update_chart_drawing; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

kind.description: Strategy/drawing category; select the exact schema enum and required matching fields.

price1.description: Drawing anchor price in the underlying quote currency; not a screen coordinate.

price2.description: Drawing anchor price in the underlying quote currency; not a screen coordinate.

name: delete_chart_drawing
description: Delete one persisted drawing by absolute zero-based index (offset + row index) using the revision from get_chart_drawings. Other drawings remain; stale revisions fail.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

index.description: index argument for delete_chart_drawing; observe this field's schema type, bounds and operation semantics.

name: clear_chart_drawings
description: Clear persisted drawings for one symbol with conflict protection.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.
